method_observation.observation: After a casualty, security, pollution or port-state event, model the seafarer's person-level legal/process availability separately from vessel status. A vessel may be released while a crew member remains interview-bound, detained or travel-restricted, and the reverse can also occur; collapsing the two hides crew availability and repatriation constraints.

seal_effect.reason: High-importance novelty remains; major coverage gaps, negative-space review and challenger gates remain incomplete.

truth_boundary: Memory-only orientation and not legal advice; no legal status, right, duty, charge, detention basis, bail/release condition, case outcome, provider capability, authority practice or jurisdiction-specific rule is verified.
